evaluation_scope: Score final C1F-valid mapping, complete typed attribution, C1E policy outcome, deterministic resolver outcome, identity-comparison outcomes, and corrective retry behavior as separate layers for every frozen v3 case.
invalid_output_rule: Every case remains in all-case and expected-class denominators. Missing or invalid final output is incorrect except for denominators explicitly conditioned on an observed valid result.
strict_identity_rule: STRICT compares issuer strings with the scorer's exact historical deterministic string canonicalization only. It is an audit metric and is never the Phase 00 primary issuer lens.
semantic_identity_rule: SEMANTIC compares issuer identities only with ai-shadow-issuer-semantic-identity-v1. EXACT and EQUIVALENT match; DISTINCT, AMBIGUOUS, and collisions do not. No fuzzy equivalence is permitted.
identity_outcome_rule: Count every issuer comparison as EXACT, EQUIVALENT, DISTINCT, or AMBIGUOUS. Identity-normalized success uses EXACT + EQUIVALENT only; DISTINCT and AMBIGUOUS never match.
equivalent_dependency_rule: Separately count semantically correct mappings and typed-attribution cases whose success depends on at least one EQUIVALENT comparison rather than exclusively EXACT comparisons.
candidate_comparison_rule: Compare principal proxy candidates as exact case-normalized bounded-exposure sets, retaining empty, singleton, and multiple-candidate cardinality.
legacy_denominator_rule: C1E3 strict denominators are not reused. Every C1F3 metric below has its own frozen denominator and both identity lenses are reported where issuer identity participates.
corrective_retry_rule: Report first-pass validity, corrective retry count and rate, retry validation-reason histogram, final validity, and semantic change after retry where determinable. Corrective retry is not repeatability.
repeatability_rule: Do not measure repeatability in C1F2A or the primary one-shot cell. If the one-shot Generalization gates pass and Boundary reveals no fundamental failure, a separately authorized frozen repeatability cell is required before Phase 00 GO.

metrics.numerator: Cases whose final attempt is accepted by ai-shadow-causal-attribution-validator-c1f-v1.
metrics.denominator: All frozen evaluated cases.

metrics.numerator: Cases whose final mapping class and selected issuer or proxy match the expected mapping under the named lens.
metrics.denominator: All frozen evaluated cases; invalid final output is incorrect.

metrics.numerator: Observed valid DIRECT cases whose expected mapping is DIRECT and issuer matches under the named lens.
metrics.denominator: All observed valid DIRECT cases.

metrics.numerator: Expected DIRECT cases observed as DIRECT with issuer matching under the named lens.
metrics.denominator: All frozen expected DIRECT cases.

metrics.numerator: Observed valid DIRECT cases not matching an expected DIRECT issuer by EXACT or EQUIVALENT.
metrics.denominator: All frozen evaluated cases; also report absolute count.

metrics.numerator: Observed valid PROXY cases matching expected PROXY and exact bounded exposure.
metrics.denominator: All observed valid PROXY cases.

metrics.numerator: Expected PROXY cases observed with the exact bounded exposure.
metrics.denominator: All frozen expected PROXY cases.

metrics.numerator: Expected UNRESOLVED cases observed as valid UNRESOLVED.
metrics.denominator: All frozen expected UNRESOLVED cases.

metrics.numerator: Cases with exact equality of complete issuer-role and principal-proxy-candidate sets under the named lens.
metrics.denominator: All frozen evaluated cases; invalid final output is incorrect.

metrics.numerator: Cases containing every expected issuer-role pair and every expected proxy candidate; extras do not repair omissions.
metrics.denominator: All frozen evaluated cases; invalid final output is incomplete.

metrics.numerator: Cases whose observed PRINCIPAL issuer set exactly matches expected under the named lens.
metrics.denominator: Cases where expected or observed valid attribution contains PRINCIPAL.

metrics.numerator: Cases whose observed EQUAL_PRINCIPAL issuer set and cardinality exactly match expected under the named lens.
metrics.denominator: Cases where expected or observed valid attribution contains EQUAL_PRINCIPAL.

metrics.numerator: Cases whose observed SECONDARY_AFFECTED issuer set exactly matches expected under the named lens.
metrics.denominator: Cases where expected or observed valid attribution contains SECONDARY_AFFECTED.

metrics.numerator: Cases whose observed CONTEXT_ONLY issuer set exactly matches expected under the named lens.
metrics.denominator: Cases where expected or observed valid attribution contains CONTEXT_ONLY.

metrics.numerator: Cases whose observed POSSIBLE_PRINCIPAL issuer set exactly matches expected under the named lens.
metrics.denominator: Cases where expected or observed valid attribution contains POSSIBLE_PRINCIPAL.

metrics.numerator: Cases whose observed principal-proxy-candidate set exactly equals expected.
metrics.denominator: All frozen evaluated cases, including expected empty sets.

metrics.numerator: Expected UNRESOLVED cases for which policy accepts DIRECT or PROXY.
metrics.denominator: All frozen expected UNRESOLVED cases; also report absolute count.

metrics.numerator: Semantically correct selectable DIRECT or PROXY raw mappings changed by policy to UNRESOLVED.
metrics.denominator: All semantically correct selectable DIRECT or PROXY raw mappings; also report absolute count.

metrics.numerator: Semantically correct policy-accepted cases resolved to an incorrect ticker or rule.
metrics.denominator: All semantically correct policy-accepted DIRECT or PROXY cases; gate the absolute numerator at zero.

metrics.numerator: Issuer comparisons returning EXACT.
metrics.denominator: All issuer comparisons attempted for mapping and typed-attribution scoring; report absolute count too.

metrics.numerator: Issuer comparisons returning EQUIVALENT.
metrics.denominator: All issuer comparisons attempted for mapping and typed-attribution scoring; report absolute count too.

metrics.numerator: Issuer comparisons returning DISTINCT.
metrics.denominator: All issuer comparisons attempted for mapping and typed-attribution scoring; report absolute count too.

metrics.numerator: Issuer comparisons returning AMBIGUOUS, including collisions.
metrics.denominator: All issuer comparisons attempted for mapping and typed-attribution scoring; report absolute count too.

metrics.numerator: Semantically correct mapping or whole-attribution results using at least one EQUIVALENT and no non-match.
metrics.denominator: All semantically correct mapping or whole-attribution results respectively; publish mapping and attribution counts separately.

metrics.numerator: Cases accepted on attempt one.
metrics.denominator: All frozen evaluated cases.

metrics.numerator: Cases for which one corrective attempt was made.
metrics.denominator: All frozen evaluated cases; report numerator as the count.

metrics.numerator: Cases for which one corrective attempt was made.
metrics.denominator: All frozen evaluated cases.

metrics.numerator: Per-reason count among attempt-one C1F validation failures that triggered correction.
metrics.denominator: All corrective retries; publish the full reason histogram.

metrics.numerator: Cases whose final attempt is C1F-valid after applying the bounded retry rule.
metrics.denominator: All frozen evaluated cases.

metrics.numerator: Retries where determinable semantic mapping or typed attribution differs between parseable attempts one and two.
metrics.denominator: Corrective retries with both attempts semantically parseable enough to compare; report indeterminate count separately.

metrics.numerator: Provider-request isolation, unauthorized persistence, database/trading mutation, or other frozen safety violations.
metrics.denominator: All frozen evaluated cases and execution-level safety checks; gate the absolute numerator at zero.
